mechanism: Time from 'Budget Owner approved' to the Supervisor decision that follows it
measures: Elapsed calendar time between the two recorded events. Includes queueing, nights, weekends, notification delay and waiting for information. Not review time.
simulator_parameter: review latency range for a quotation reviewer (upper envelope)
estimable_note: No start-of-work events and no queue position, so work time cannot be separated out; usable only as an upper envelope.

value.interval_95_meaning: central 95% of observed gaps (2.5th to 97.5th percentile), not a CI

conditions: Eindhoven University of Technology travel expense declarations (domestic), 2017 two departments, 2018 whole university; staff anonymised to roles; Budget Owner approved then Supervisor
transfer: Analogue range for how long a quotation reviewer takes to respond at a comparable load, as an upper envelope (it includes queueing). Use the empirical quantiles; no fitted distribution is endorsed.

source.name: BPI Challenge 2020: Domestic Declarations
source.creator: Boudewijn van Dongen, Eindhoven University of Technology
